The design is now fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

**Bug:** `in_ready` was computed as `out_free || !full`, which ignored `in_last` as a closing condition. This meant a beat with `in_last=1` (closing the word early) would be accepted even while the output register was occupied and not draining, causing the in-flight word to be silently overwritten/dropped instead of correctly back-pressuring.

**Fix:** Changed `in_ready` to `out_free || !closes` (where `closes = full || in_last`), matching spec rule 3 exactly — a closing beat is only accepted when the output register is empty or is being delivered that same cycle.
